full_judgment: 5. Defendant No. 2, Government of Bangladesh filed written statement contending that the suit plot being canal has been recorded in the name of the government and it is being used by the local people. Some people of the locality encroached the canal and erected structure therein. When notices were issued against the illegal occupiers they took various pretext of having taken license from the District Council. It is further asserted that the suit land being part of khatian No. 1 it cannot be leased out by District Council without the permission of the concerned ministry.
